tei:div.tei:p: (ba)༄༅// sa skya pa'i nyin zhag phrugs gcig gi thugs dam gtor ma'i rim pa bzhugs// ༄༅// bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// chos rje sa skya pa yab sras kyi nyin zhag phrugs gcig la thugs dam du mdzad pa'i gtor ma'i rim pa ni/ tsha ba'i gong tho rangs kyi cha la/ dkar gtor bzhi mdzad pa'i thog mar rje btsun mi g.yo ba la dbul te/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa ces brjod pas gtor ma'i ma dag pa bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddha ssarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shuddho3 haṃ gis stong par bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las/ oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang bar bsams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi byin gyis brlab/ de nas rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ rje btsun mi g.yo ba mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs la/ gtor ma phul bas gsol ba bsam zhing*/ oṃ tsaṇḍa ma hā ro kṣa ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa lan gsum mam/ bdun gyis phul nas/ oṃ arghaṃ/ pā dyaṃ/ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐/ badzra dhū pe āḥhūm̐/ badzra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐/ badzra gandhe āḥhūm̐/ badzra nai wi dye āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas mchod nas/ kye kye mtha' gnyis rnam par ma g.yos shing*// sprul pa'i gzugs kyis 'gro don dpag med mdzad// 'jigs byed chen po 'gro ba kun sgrol zhing*// srid pa gsum na dgyes pa'i gar mdzad de// srid pa'i chu bo skems shing mi mthun bdud rnams 'joms// srid pa'i rlung gis ma g.yos thugs rje mi g.yo mgon// rab brjid mi g.yo mgon la gus pas phyag 'tshal bstod// ces pas bstod nas/ bdag gi bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi ba dang*/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab bo// mi g.yo ba'i drug cu rtsa bzhi pa la sogs pa gtong bar 'dod na'ang tshul 'di nyid kyis gtang bar bya'o// gnyis pa snga ma ltar byin gyis brlabs la/

lho phyogs ri bo po ti la na/ rje btsun ma sgrol ma 'khor dang bcas pa mngon sum du bzhugs pa la phul bar bsam zhing*/ na maḥsarba buddha bo dhi satwā nāṃ a pra ti ha ta shā sa nā nāṃ he he bha ga wa te ma hā satwa/ sarba buddha a wa lo ki te/ mā bi laṃ pa/ mā bi laṃ pa/ i daṃ ba liṃ grihnā pa ya grihnā pa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ sarba bi sañtsa re swā hā/ zhes lan gsum gyis phul nas/ snga ma ltar mchod la/ lha dang lha min cod pan gyis// zhabs kyi padmo la btud pa// phongs pa kun las sgrol mdzad ma// sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas bstod nas snga ma ltar gsol ba gdab bo// nyi shu rtsa gcig ma la sogs pa gtong bar 'dod na'ang tshul 'di nyid kyis gtang bar bya'o// gsum pa klu rnams la dbul te/ gtor ma la rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi phyag rgya bstan la/ oṃ badzra yakṣa hūm̐ zhes lan gsum brjod pas ma dag pa bsang*/ rdo rje me'i phyag rgya bstan nas/ oṃ badzra dzwā la a na la ha na da ha pa tsa ma tha bhañdza ra ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod pas rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba bdud rtsis gang bar bsam/ rdo rje bsdams pa'i phyag rgya 'debs pa'i tshul du bya zhing*/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇāṃ ādya nutpanna twād oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes lan gsum brjod pas gtor ma las klu rnams kyis ci 'dod pa'i yo byad thogs pa med par 'byung bar bsam/ 'dod pa'i rgyal po'i phyag rgya bcas la/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas klu'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa dang*/ bye brag tu rang la gnod par byed pa'i klu thams cad spyan drangs par bsam zhing*/ oṃ ba ta li pha ta li/ ma hā ba ta li hūm̐ hūm̐ dzaḥdzaḥswā hā/ zhes lan gsum dang*/ oṃ klu rgyal mtha' yas nor rgyas bu// 'jog po dang ni stobs kyi rgyu// padma padma chen po dang*// dung skyong dang ni rigs ldan no// lha mo lha mo chen mo dang*// zla ba'i spyi gtsug spyi gtsug che// dbyug 'dzin dbyug 'dzin chen po dang*// sog ma med dang hu lunta// dga' bo dang ni nye dga' bo// rgya mtsho rgya mtsho chen po dang*// tsha ba tsha ba chen po dang*// dpal gyi 'od dang 'od po che// rin chen 'od dang gzugs mdzes dang*// gzugs mdzes chen po sbrul bzang dang*// lto 'phye che dang tshi li dang*// tshi li chen po rnam dag ni// mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// zhes pa dang*/

oṃ ā gatstsha ya/ ā gatstsha ya/ ma hā nā ga a dhi pa ta ye/ sarba bhurbhu ba phruṃ phuḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhes brjod pas mdun du byon par bsam/ padma ka ma lā ya st+waṃ/ zhes pas so so la padma'i gdan dbul/ oṃ ma hā nā ga a dhi pa ta ye gṛhṇe daṃ/ zhes kun la sbyar la/ arghaṃ swā hās mchod yon/ pā dyaṃ swā hās zhabs bsil/ puṣpaṃ swā hās me tog dhū paṃ swā hās bdug spos/ dī paṃ swā hās mar me/ gandhaṃ swā hās dri/ nai bi dye swā hās zhal zas phul nas klu thams cad kyis gtor ma gsol bar bsam zhing*/ klu dga' bar byed pa'i phyag rgya bcas nas/ oṃ hi li hi li ma hā hi li phruṃ phraṃ phraṃ swā hā/ zhes brjod nas se gol brdabs pas gtor snod re re la gsum gsum dang*/ oṃ bhakṣa ya bhakṣa ya sa ma ya ti dzuṃ phruṃ phuḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhes lan gsum gsum brjod pas phul nas/ ye dharmā dang*/ sdig pa ci yang mi bya ste// dge ba phun sum tshogs par spyad// rang gi sems ni yongs su gdul// 'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin// zhes chos kyi sbyin pa byin nas/ klu'i rgyal po brgyad kyis gtso byas pa'i klu'i rigs su gyur pa thams cad dang*/ bye brag tu bdag la gnod cing*/ lan chags pa'i klu dang*/ sa bdag thams cad gtor ma 'dis tshim par gyur cig gnod pa dang gdug pa'i sems nye bar zhi nas/ phan pa dang byang chub kyi sems dang ldan par gyur cig ces brjod nas/ oṃ nā ga a dhi pa ti/ sa pa ri wā ra gatstsha/ zhes brjod pas rang rang gi gnas su gshegs par bsam/ bya khyung gi phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ ga ru ṭa haṃ sa he tsa le tsa le swā hā/ zhes brjod pas nag po'i klu'i rigs thams cad bskrad par bsam mo// bzhi pa su rū pa'i sngags kyis yi dwags rnams la sbyin par bya ste/ rang skad cig gis de bzhin gshegs pa gzugs mdzes su bsgoms la/ gtor ma oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por byin gyis brlabs nas/

lag pa g.yas pa mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya byas la/ na maḥsu rū pā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ arha te saṃ myaksṃ buddhā ya/ tadya thā/ oṃ su ru su ru/ pra su ru pra su ru/ ta ra ta ra/ bha ra bha ra/ sambha ra sambha ra/ sma ra sma ra santarpa ya/ sarba pre tā nāṃ swā hā/ zhes lan bdun brjod pas yi dwags rnams kyi mdun du zad mi shes pa'i bdud rtsi dang*/ 'dod pa'i yon tan thams cad 'byung bar bsam zhing*/ a pa sa rantu a ba tā ra/ pre kṣi ṇo dhwa me ham̐/ sarba lo ka dhā tu bha sī naṃ/ sarba pre tā nā ma hā raṃ/ zhes brjod pas phan tshun 'dzer ba dang*/ 'thab rtsod la sogs pa med par ci bde bar mnyam por thob cing*/ longs spyad nas bde bar tshim par bsam mo// de nas ye dharmā la sogs pas chos kyi sbyin pa byin nas/ sgrib pa gnyis byang*/ se gol brdabs pas rang gi gnas su byer bar bsam mo// 'di'i phan yon ni/ skye ba nas skye bar dbul por mi 'gyur ba dang*/ stobs che ba dang*/ gzugs bzang zhing mthong na dga' bar 'gyur ba dang*/ phyug cing longs spyod che ba dang*/ tshe ring ba dang*/ nad med pa dang*/ myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par 'gyur ro// shi 'phos nas kyang 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can du skye bar 'gyur ro// zhes mdo las 'byung ngo*/ de nas kha zas mi thob pa'i yi dwags rnams la chu sbyin par bya ste/ rang skad cig gis 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas pa mchog sbyin byas par bsgoms la/ chu dang snod la sogs pa thams cad la zas kyis ma gos par bya zhing*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlabs pa/ lag pa g.yas pa'i mthil du mthe bong bzhag nas/ spyan ras gzigs kyi phyag g.yas pa nas byung ba'i bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis kha 'bar ma dang 'jur gegs la sogs pa'i yi dwags kyi tshogs thams cad tshim par bsam zhing*/ oṃ āḥhrīḥhūm̐ zhes ci rigs pa bgrangs pa'i mthar oṃ dzwa la mi daṃ sarba pre te bhyaḥswā hā/

zhes bya bas kyang bsngos nas/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang gi /phyag nas 'bab pa'i 'o rgyun gyis// yi dwags rnams ni tshim gyur nas// khrus byas rtag tu bsil bar shog /ces brjod la slar yang chos kyi sbyin pa byin nas/ se gol brdabs pas rang rang gi gnas su byer bar bsam mo// gshin rje gshed dgra nag po'i rgyud las/ lo re'am ni zla re'am// de bzhin nyi ma so so la// gtor ma drug cu rtsa bzhi gtang*// dbyu gu drug cu bzhir shes bya// zhes 'byung bas nyi ma gung gi cha la rdo rje pho nya mo drug cu rtsa bzhi mnyes shing*/ dbyu gu drug cu rtsa bzhis dus la bar chad mi 'byung bar bya ba'i phyir/ gtor ma drug cu rtsa bzhir mdzad de/ sha khrag dang ma 'dres pa'i gtor ma grangs drug cu rtsa bzhi 'byung ba bshams la/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ sems bskyed pa sngon du song nas rang skad cig gis yi dam gyi lhar bsam/ gtor ma oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi byin gyis brlabs pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsis 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshogs thams cad mchod par bsam zhing*/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇāṃ/ ādya nutpanna twāta/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pas bsngos nas/ 'phags pa'i tshogs rnams mnyes shing*/ rigs drug gis sems can thams cad tshim par gyur cig ces brjod do// de'i rjes la yang snga ma ltar yi dwags rnams la chu sbyin par bya'o// de nas rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa bdun dang sbyor ba nyi shu rtsa bdun gyi gnod pa mi 'byung bar bya ba'i phyir/ gtor ma nyi shu rtsa bdun ma gtang bar bya ste/ gsum tshan dgur byas pa'i dang po rje btsun mi g.yo ba dang*/ gnyis pa rje btsun ma sgrol ma la snga ma ltar phul la gsol ba gdab/ gsum pa'i dang po sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang*/ gnyis pa rang gi chos skyong dang*/ gsum pa chos skyong ba'i srung ma spyi la/ a kā ro'i sngags kyis dbul/

bzhi pa lha'i drang srong dang*/ lnga pa lhan cig skyes pa'i lha dang*/ drug pa rigs drug dang*/ bdun pa yi dwags dang*/ brgyad pa lan chags dang glo bur du lhags pa'i 'byung po rnams la sbyin te/ thams cad kyang oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs nas/ lag pa g.yas pa mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya bcas la/ mgron so so la mchod cing*/ sbyin par bsams la/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta/ a ba lo ki ta/ oṃ saṃ bha ra saṃ bha ra hūm̐/ zhes gtor ma'i snod re re la'ang lan gsum gsum mam bdun bdun brjod pas phul nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen mang la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes brjod pas gtor ma 'dod pa'i longs spyod lngas brgyan pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen po dpag tu med par gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa gzugs dam pa la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes brjod pas gtor ma'i mgron rnams nad med cing gzugs phun sum tshogs pa dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa sku 'byam klas la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes brjod pas gnod pa med cing lus la phan par longs spyod par gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'jigs pa thams cad dang bral ba la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes brjod pas gnod pa dang*/ 'jigs pa thams cad dang bral bar gyur par bsam mo// kha 'bar ma'i brgya rtsa gtong bar 'dod pas kyang*/ tshul 'di nyid kyis gtong bar bya'o// dgu pa a kā ro'i sngags kyis gzhi'i bdag po rnams la sbyin no// de'i mthar yang yi dwags rnams la chu sbyin par bya'o// 'jig rten pa'i mgron de dag thams cad la'ang*/ thun mong du chos kyi sbyin pa'ang sbyin zhing*/ 'dod pa'i don rnams kyang bsgo bar bya'o// de nas se gol brdabs nas/ oṃ sarba bhū ta gatstsha/ zhes brjod pas mgron rnams rang rang gi gnas su dengs par bsams nas/ dge ba'i rtsa ba rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngo'o// de nas phyogs skyong dang 'byung po'i gtor ma ni/ dkar gtor gtsang ma gnyis bshams pa klu gtor ltar byin gyis brlabs pa la/

rang yi dam gyi lha'i nga rgyal brtan po dang ldan pa'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros pas/ phyogs skyong ba bcu po 'khor dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs par bsam zhing*/ shar phyogs rdo rje can gyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas// gtor ma phul ba 'di dag bzhes su gsol// me dang gshin rje bden bral srin po'i bdag /chu bdag rlung bdag nor gyi bdag po dang*// dbang ldan lha ste 'byung po'i bdag po dang*// steng gi nyi zla tshangs pa chen po dang*// lha rnams kun dang gang dag sa steng klu// ri yi lha dang gtsang ma'i tshogs bcas la// sa sa so sor gtor ma phul ba 'di// rab tu dgyes pa'i tshul gyis bzhes nas su// rang rang phyogs su legs par bzhugs nas kyang*// rang gi bu smad mdza' bshes gnyen 'dun dang*// nang mi dmag dang dpung bcas lhan cig tu// phreng ba me tog dri dang bdug par bcas// bstod dang gtor ma mar me gus 'bul na// 'di dag gsol zhing legs par bsnams nas su// rang rang phyogs su legs par bzhugs nas kyang*// bdag gi las kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod// oṃ ind+rā ya/ agna ye/ ya mā ya/ nair ṛ tye/ bā ru ṇā ya/ bā ya be/ ku be rā ya/ ī sha nā ya/ urdhaṃ brahma/ sūrya gra ha/ a dhi pa ta ye/ tsand+ra nakṣa tra a dhi pa ta ye e hye hi/ zhes pas spyan drangs/ padma ka ma lā ya st+waṃ gyis gdan dbul/ oṃ da sha di ka lo ka pā la gṛhṇe daṃ zhes kun la sbyar la/ arghaṃ swā hā/ pā dyaṃ swā hā/ puṣpaṃ swā hā/ dhū paṃ swā hā/ dī paṃ swā hā/ gandhaṃ swā hās mchod pa rnams phul nas/ sa ma ya st+waṃ zhes brjod pas dam la bzhag par bsam/ de nas gtor ma phul ba phyogs skyong ba 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyis gsol bas/ tshim par bsam zhing*/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ ind+rā ya zhes pa nas/ tsand+ra nakṣa tra a dhi pa ta ye/ zhes pa'i bar gyi mthar/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyo bi shwa mu khe bhyaḥ

sarba thā khaṃ uṅga te/ spha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛhṇe daṃ ba linta ye swā hā/ zhes brjod nas se gol brdabs pa gsum mam bdun gyis phul la/ slar yang arghaṃ la sogs pas mchod de/ dbang po rdo rje 'chang ba'i lha// lha yi rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /shar phyogs gdon gyi tshogs bcas pa// mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// me ste bsreg bya za ba'i lha// drang srong rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /shar lho gdon gyi tshogs bcas la// mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// gshin rje be con 'chang ba'i lha// ma mo'i rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /lho phyogs gdon gyi tshogs bcas la// mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// bden dang bral ba legs ldan lha// srin po'i rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /lho nub gdon gyi tshogs bcas la// mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// zhags pa thogs pa chu yi lha// klu yi rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /nub phyogs gdon gyi tshogs bcas la// mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// rlung ste srog kyang 'dzin pa'i lha// rig 'dzin rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /nub byang gdon gyi tshogs bcas la// mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// gnod sbyin lag na dbyug to thogs// nor skyong rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /byang phyogs gdon gyi tshogs bcas la// mchod cing bstod de phyag 'tshal// dbang dang ldan pa 'dren pa'i lha// 'byung po'i rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /byang shar gdon gyi tshogs bcas la// mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// steng gi tshangs pa chen po dang*// nyi ma zla ba gza' chen po// gza' dang rgyu skar bcas pa la// mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// 'og gi klu ste sa yi bdag /sa 'dzin lag pa chen po dang*// dam tshig shes pa'i tshogs bcas la// mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// zhes pas bstod nas/ rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la// nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*// dpal dang grags dang skal ba bzang*// longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing*// zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi// las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol// dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs// dngos grub kun gyis stong grogs mdzod// dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang*// gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod// rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan// bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod// 'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*// 'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel dang*// bde legs thams cad 'byung ba dang*// yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog

/ces pas phrin las bcol nas/ dngos grub ma lus pa gnang bar bsam mo// yang rang gi snying ga nas 'od 'phros pas/ lha klu khyad par can rnams kyis gtso byas pa 'byung po'i tshogs rnams mdun gyi nam mkhar bkug par bsam zhing*/ lha dang lha min gnod sbyin lto 'phye grul// nam mkha' lding dang 'dab bzangs lus srul po// dri za srin po gdon gyi tshogs rnams dang*// gang dag sa la gnas pa'i rdzu 'phrul can// bu smad bcas shing 'khor g.yog bcas pa la// bdag gi pus mo sa la btsugs nas ni// thal mo sbyar nas khyed la gsol 'debs kyis// gsan nas phan gdags slad du 'dir gshegs shig /oṃ de wa nā ga yakṣa gandharbha/ a su ra/ ga ru ḍa/ kinna ra/ ma ho ra ga ma nu ṣya/ a ma nu ṣya/ e hye his spyan drangs/ snga ma ltar gdan dbul/ mchod pas mchod/ dam la bzhag nas/ oṃ de wa nas/ a ma nu ṣya'i bar gyi mthar/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te la sogs pas phyag rgya dang bcas pa gsum mam bdun gyis gtor ma phul ba thams cad kyis gsol zhing mnyes par bsgoms la/ arghaṃ la sogs pas mchod nas/ 'byung po gang dag ri rab steng gnas dang*// dga' ba'i tshal dang lha yi gnas rnams dang*// shar nub ri dang nyi zla'i khyim rnams dang*// ri bor kun la gang dag gnas pa dang*// rin chen gling na lhag par gang gnas dang*// chu bo kun dang chu bo'i mdo rnams dang*// mtsho dang rdzing bu lteng ka chu ngogs dang*// g.ya' chu sil ma can na gnas pa dang*// grong dang phyugs lhas grong khyer stong pa dang*// khang stong dag dang lha yi khang pa dang*// gtsug lag khang dang mchod rten gnas rnams dang*// dka' thub gnas dang glang chen bres rnams dang*// rgyal po'i dkor khang dag na gang gnas dang*// lam srang sum mdo dang ni bzhi mdo dang*// gang dag lam po che dang shing gcig drung*// dur khrod chen po nags tshal chen po dang*// seng ge dred dang gcan gzan gnas rnams dang*// 'brog chen 'jigs su rung bar gang
